1. (Currently amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) for enabling a user to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data includes __at least one of: a spatial coordinate of the graphical element on the medical image, a measurement derived from the graphical element, or an identifier of an anatomical structure marked by the graphical element__; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) configured to:
i) access a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414),
ii) retrieve a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item __through a rule-based mapping that correlates specific spatial positions, measurement values, or anatomical structure identifications to corresponding medical information items__, and
iii) generate a report (182) based on the medical information item __by automatically populating report fields with codified medical reference information derived from the retrieved medical information item__.

2. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182) __by applying a transformation function that converts the medical reference information into a standardized coded format compatible with medical reporting standards__.

3. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element __such that selection of the graphical element automatically triggers retrieval and inclusion of the associated codified medical reference information in the report__.

4. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414) __wherein the macro comprises a set of programmatic instructions that execute upon detection of the application data to automatically transform and encode the medical reference information__.

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks, and wherein the user interface subsystem (180) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414).

7. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412), and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay.

8. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement __wherein the measurement data includes numerical values and units of measurement that are automatically captured and stored as part of the application data__.

9. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182) __by automatically inserting the measurement data into predefined report fields and performing calculations based on the measurement data to generate clinically relevant metrics__.

10. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066) __wherein each rule specifies a condition based on the application data that, when satisfied, triggers retrieval of the corresponding medical information item__.

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image __wherein the application data includes at least one of: a spatial coordinate of the graphical element on the medical image, a measurement derived from the graphical element, or an identifier of an anatomical structure marked by the graphical element__;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item __through a rule-based mapping that correlates specific spatial positions, measurement values, or anatomical structure identifications to corresponding medical information items__; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item __by automatically populating report fields with codified medical reference information derived from the retrieved medical information item__.

15. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
